title: pyrethrum vulgare
intro: Pyrethrum vulgare, commonly known as the daisy or pyrethrum, is a perennial plant in the sunflower family (Asteraceae) native to Europe and Asia, known for its vibrant yellow flowers and medicinal properties. The health benefits of Pyrethrum vulgare include its ability to act as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic, making it effective in treating wounds, skin conditions, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of the plant include reducing fever, relieving pain, and soothing digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Pyrethrum vulgare include sesquiterpene lactones, particularly pyrethrin I and II, which possess insecticidal and antimicrobial properties.
